stage_a_identity.rule: The external Stage-A result, representation, candidates and Stage-A runner must be hash-bound by the future CY-035 authorization and manifest. A true gate and false outcome-read declaration are necessary but not sufficient.

data.path_scope: Only exact frozen candidate symbols may be joined, and returned rows must be strictly after each event's signal cal_idx and no later than 2020-12-31. No arbitrary signal-relative path truncation is permitted.

must_bind: CY-034 upstream manifest path and SHA-256
parent V30 freeze path and SHA-256
this Stage-B freeze path and SHA-256
external Stage-A result path and SHA-256
required_future_registry_authorization.runner_hash_rule: This freeze and the runner contain no placeholder or self-referential expected Stage-B runner hash. The registry authorization must record the completed runner's actual SHA-256, and runtime must compare that registered value with sha256(__file__).

outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market cal_idx signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Any non-finite or changed invalid_step_cum invalidates before entry. Otherwise execute the first legal non-limit-up raw open and fill at its positive finite coordinate open.
outcome_attachment.legal_row: Known trade_status=1, current_day_data_tradable, current_valid, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, non-blocking, explicitly zero corporate_action_count, hard_valid, finite positive raw open, coordinate open and coordinate factor, with available_at no later than decision_at.
outcome_attachment.buy_limit: The rounded raw open in fen must be strictly below the rounded finite positive raw up_limit_price in fen.
outcome_attachment.target: Before fallback eligibility, the first later same-lineage legal row whose finite coordinate high is at least entry coordinate price times 1.10 exits at the exact coordinate target only when raw high and raw down-limit are finite and positive and rounded raw high is strictly above rounded raw down-limit. Unknown limit state or an all-day locked down-limit bar can never create a target fill. On a fallback-eligible row, the chronological open rule below is evaluated first.
outcome_attachment.fallback: On the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, evaluate the open before using any same-day high. If the open is sellable and coordinate open is at or above target, exit at the exact target as TARGET_10. If the open is sellable and below target, exit immediately at coordinate open as H20_TIME_STOP. Only when that open is not sellable may a later same-day legal coordinate-high target touch exit at the exact target; otherwise continue to the next row.
outcome_attachment.sell_limit: The rounded raw open in fen must be strictly above the rounded finite positive raw down_limit_price in fen.
outcome_attachment.fallback_day_chronology: The fallback-eligible open decision precedes all same-day high information. Exact-target treatment of a sellable open at or above target declines favorable gap slippage; immediate time-stop treatment of a sellable open below target declines hindsight use of a later intraday high. A target after an unsellable open is allowed only when the same legal row later records a coordinate high at the target, and still fills only at the exact target. These are conservative execution semantics, not a signal rule.
outcome_attachment.no_entry: NO_LEGAL_ENTRY; never substitute a close, a same-session fill or a row after signal+3.
outcome_attachment.lineage: Every inspected entry-window and post-entry row must have a finite invalid_step_cum equal to the signal value. Any non-finite or changed value invalidates immediately; never normalize, splice or repair coordinates.
outcome_attachment.corporate_action_unknown: Every physically present entry-window and post-entry row must have non-null corporate_action_count, corporate_action_valid and corporate_action_blocking. Unknown action state invalidates the event immediately before or after entry rather than being skipped and later recovered under an unchanged lineage counter.

outputs.publication: Build all files in a same-parent temporary directory, close DuckDB, remove temporary work files, then atomically rename the complete directory. Refuse to run if the canonical Stage-B directory already exists and recheck immediately before publish.

required_audits: candidate and representation hashes exactly match this freeze
Stage-A result gate is true and all outcome/post-2020 read flags are false
future CY-035 registry asset, authorization, manifest and runner hash all match
candidate event_ids are non-null and unique
path (event_id,cal_idx) keys are unique and map only to the exact candidate event/symbol pairs
no path row is at or before its signal cal_idx or after 2020-12-31
outcome event_id set equals the candidate event_id set exactly
entry cal_idx is signal+1 through signal+3 and every exit is strictly after entry
unknown corporate-action state is retained as an explicit invalid-before-entry or invalid-after-entry lifecycle
every target fill has a finite positive raw high and down-limit with rounded raw high strictly above rounded down-limit
completed returns are finite and all completed exits are no later than 2020-12-31
prohibited: running before the separate CY-035 authorization and manifest exist and bind the completed runner
reading or reusing any pre-existing V30 outcome artifact
reading path rows after 2020-12-31 or for non-candidate symbols
limit-price, suspension, invalid-row or corporate-action relaxation
target, horizon, entry-window or cost variation
portfolio replay, chart-rule compression or 2021-plus read
overwriting or merging into an existing canonical Stage-B directory
